title: GIFT-Eval-CTX: A Benchmark For Contextual Forecasting Model Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.17794v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contextual forecasting seeks to improve time series forecasting by incorporating forward-looking information, such as planned events, external conditions, and expert expectations. However, reliable evaluation remains difficult: existing benchmarks often have limited domain coverage, lack standardized history-future splits, or provide text that is not guaranteed to inform the future. We introduce GIFT-Eval-CTX, a benchmark that isolates whether forecasting methods can translate verified future information into accurate numerical trajectories. Built upon GIFT-Eval, GIFT-Eval-CTX contains 10,000 instances across 20 datasets. Each instance provides structured effects derived from the realized future: Macro effects describe horizon-wide behavior, while Micro effects specify localized changes. We construct these annotations with an agentic pipeline combining LLM-based discovery and deterministic code validation. We benchmark TSFMs, frontier

translated_title: GIFT-Eval-CTX：一个用于上下文预测模型评估的基准
translated_abstract: 上下文预测旨在通过引入前瞻性信息（如计划中的事件、外部条件和专家预期）来改进时间序列预测。然而，可靠的评估仍然困难：现有基准往往领域覆盖有限、缺乏标准化的历史-未来划分，或所提供的文本无法保证与未来相关。我们提出 GIFT-Eval-CTX，这是一个能够隔离检验预测方法能否将经过验证的未来信息转化为准确数值轨迹的基准。该基准基于 GIFT-Eval 构建，包含跨 20 个数据集的 10,000 个实例。每个实例都提供从已实现的未来中提取的结构化效应：宏观效应描述整个预测范围的行为，微观效应则刻画局部变化。我们通过一个结合基于 LLM 的发现与确定性代码验证的智能体流水线来构建这些标注。我们对时间序列基础模型（TSFM）和前沿模型进行了基准测试。
tldr: 提出 GIFT-Eval-CTX 基准，包含跨 20 个数据集的 10,000 个带有从已实现未来中提取的结构化宏观与微观效应标注的实例，用于系统评估预测模型能否将经验证的未来信息转化为准确的数值预测轨迹。
en_tdlr: We introduce GIFT-Eval-CTX, a benchmark with 10,000 instances across 20 datasets annotated with structured macro and micro effects derived from realized futures, to systematically evaluate whether forecasting models can translate verified future information into accurate numerical trajectories.
